subject: Inference economics: implementation canary & tuning plan
messages:
From: Oliver Hayes <oliver.hayes@lumenhealth.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ava Patel <ava.patel@lumenhealth.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: cost & perf plan for inference rollout

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We want to move into a guided implementation with Redwood for our inference layer — specifically we need a detailed plan on how to hit our latency and cost targets while we ramp traffic. High level asks:

- Can you lead a kickoff that covers batching, KV/prefix caching, quantization profile recommendations, and routing policies (primary vs fallback models)?
- We want a canary rollout approach (low % traffic, 48–72h burn) and a rollback plan tied to error/latency budgets.
- Target SLO: p95 <= 200ms for short replies, sustained QPS ~ 120 requests/sec after month 1.
- Budget target: <$0.008/token effective (benchmarking against current infra).

Available this week: Wed 09/22 after 1pm PT or Thu 09/23 in the morning.

I attached our throughput profile and sample prompt mix for reference.

Thanks — looking forward to lining up owners so we can start a short implementation sprint.

—Oliver
Oliver Hayes
Head of ML Platform
Lumen Health AI

Attachments: lumen_qps_profile.csv (text/csv), sample_prompts.json (application/json)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Oliver Hayes <oliver.hayes@lumenhealth.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 12:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: cost & perf plan for inference rollout

Oliver — thanks for the clear ask and the files. Happy to own the kickoff and run the implementation cadence. Quick plan proposal (high level):

1) Pre-kickoff (we send a short questionnaire + config checklist) — owners: Marissa (program), Karthik (quant & routing), Monica (batching/caching).
2) Kickoff workshop (60–90m): review traffic profile, define SLOs, pick initial quant profile candidates, and agree canary guardrails.
3) Sprint 0 (2 weeks): baseline measurements on host + 2 quant profiles, batching & KV cache params, and a dry-run in staging.
4) Canary (48h suggested minimum): start 1% traffic, step to 5% if p95 & error metrics OK, then 20% steady before full cutover.
5) Post-canary: optimize batching params and routing fallbacks (cost vs latency tradeoffs) and lock rollout.

I've attached our standard implementation checklist and a draft canary routing policy to accelerate decisions. Please confirm whether Wed 09/22 1:30–2:30pm PT or Thu 09/23 9:00–10:00am PT works — I'll send a calendar invite with an agenda and owners.

Pre-kickoff asks from our side:
- Your preferred quantization tolerance (quality delta acceptable) or examples of outputs we should validate.
- Any model variants you expect to use (open model names or internal checkpoints).
- Security questionnaire point-of-contact (for SOC2 / audit evidence).

If that schedule works I'll add tentative tasks to the mutual action plan and loop in SRE and engineering owners.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: RI-implementation-checklist.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet), canary-routing-policy-draft.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Oliver Hayes <oliver.hayes@lumenhealth.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ava Patel <ava.patel@lumenhealth.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2027 08:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: cost & perf plan for inference rollout

Marissa — Wed 1:30pm PT works for us. Confirmed.

Quick answers to pre-kickoff asks:
- Quant tolerance: we can accept up to a 2% semantic similarity delta on classification/intent tasks; for clinical summarization we prefer <1% — we'll flag evaluation prompts.
- Models: starting with open-llama-13b-v2 (quant-friendly) and an internal tuned checkpoint for sensitive content.
- Security/contact: Ava Patel (cc) will own the security questionnaire and provide SOC2 evidence.

Attached: lumen_qps_profile.csv (your team can use this for batching sims) and a short doc with our critical evaluation prompts. We expect a steady-state 120 QPS but with burst spikes to 300 QPS for 30s windows during morning churn.

On canary duration — we prefer an initial 72h window to capture burst behavior, but we can be conservative and instrument after 48h to decide.

Thanks — see you Wed.

—Oliver

To: Oliver Hayes <oliver.hayes@lumenhealthai.com>, Ava Patel <ava.patel@lumenhealth.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Sep 2027 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: cost & perf plan for inference rollout — Agenda & action items

Team — calendar invite sent for Wed 09/22 1:30–2:30pm PT (meeting in 1hr). Final agenda and immediate action items below: 

Agenda (60m)
- 5m intro & success criteria (Marissa)
- 15m traffic profile & SLO alignment (Oliver)
- 20m low-latency config: batching strategy & KV cache policy (Monica)
- 10m quant & runtime tradeoffs (Karthik)
- 10m canary windows, rollback, instrumentation (All)

Immediate action items (owner / due):
- Oliver: share the evaluation prompt set and call out the clinical summarization samples (done; thanks). (Due: EOD today)
- Ava: point-of-contact for SOC2 evidence and email the questionnaire responses. (Due: Mon 09/27)
- Karthik: prepare two quant profile candidates and an initial routing policy that favors low-latency variants for p95-critical routes. (Due: Mon 09/27)
- Monica: run a staging batching simulation using lumen_qps_profile.csv and share recommended batch sizes and cache TTLs. (Due: Tue 09/28)
- Marissa: prepare the mutual action plan doc and create a canary playbook with thresholds and escalations. (Due: Mon 09/27)

Notes: we'll instrument token-level cost reporting and a p95 latency dashboard during the canary. If p95 > 250ms or error rate rises by >0.5% we'll pause and roll back.

I'll attach the mutual action plan doc after the call and follow up with the RA/infra owners to request a staging slot.

See you on the call — thanks all.

Best,
Marissa
